$comment: Pre-existing broken --wim-color-* references found when scss-token-refs integrity checking was introduced. These resolve to no token (the CSS property silently does nothing). Fixing each is a design call (the intended token was never defined), so they are baselined here as a ratchet: the guard fails on any NEW orphan but tolerates these known ones. Remove an entry once its reference is fixed; do not add new entries.
